compose.title: Compose
compose.description: Barrel of the composed primitives (compose/index), imported by components and blocks

faq-simple.title: Faq Simple
faq-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the questions with their answers as a list, each under a rule, in two columns or one.

features-simple.title: Features Simple
features-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the features as a list (an icon disc, a title, a line): in columns under the heading or beside it, the icon on top or at the side.

gallery-hero.title: Gallery Hero
gallery-hero.description: The heading, one paragraph and up to two links as the actions beside three or four photos: at the end, at the start, or in a row under the copy.

hero-simple.title: Hero Simple
hero-simple.description: A badge, the heading, one paragraph and up to two links as the actions (primary, then secondary), with one picture at the end, at the start (landscape or portrait), on top or at the bottom.

intro-simple.title: Intro Simple
intro-simple.description: Text only: a badge, a large heading, one paragraph and up to two links as the actions (primary, then secondary), centred or at the start, in the middle of the section or low in a tall one.

logos-simple.title: Logos Simple
logos-simple.description: A short heading over the logos as a list: a wrapping row or a grid of cards.

photos-simple.title: Photos Simple
photos-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the photos as a list in two, three or four columns.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.description: Recipes (Tailwind classes per variant/size/state) of the composed primitives

split-simple.title: Split Simple
split-simple.description: Two halves: the heading, one paragraph and up to two links as the actions (primary, then secondary) beside one picture that fills its half to the edge of the screen.

stats-simple.title: Stats Simple
stats-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the figures as a list (a large value, a label, a note), in two, three or four columns, plain or on cards.

steps-simple.title: Steps Simple
steps-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the steps as an ordered list (a label, a title, a line), in a row of three or four, or one under the other.

stories-simple.title: Stories Simple
stories-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the stories as a list (a cover, the title as a link, a line): cards in two or three columns, or compact rows on a card surface.

team-simple.title: Team Simple
team-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the people as a list: a portrait, the name and the role, in two, three or four columns, plain or on cards.

testimonials-simple.title: Testimonials Simple
testimonials-simple.description: The heading, one paragraph and the quotes as a list (the words, a portrait, the name and the role): on cards in two or three columns, in rows with the portrait at the side, or centred.

theme-amber-minimal.title: Amber Minimal
theme-amber-minimal.description: Skin Amber Minimal: brand tokens (colours, radius, shadows, fonts) for every UI8Kit component, light and dark; on with data-skin="amber-minimal".

theme-base.title: Theme Base
theme-base.description: Start values of a skin scoped on an element (data-skin on any element but <html>): the kit font, tracking, radius and shadows, so the element shows its own skin only. Licences of the skins in NOTICE.md.
